name: FAKE LILY
source: Kuroyuri is a girl who distrusts men. It's been half a year since she entered her dream boarding school for girls. She's having a great time and she's planning to confess her feelings to her best friend...
translation: 黑百合是一个不信任男人的女孩。进入她梦想的女子寄宿学校已经半年了。她玩得很开心，并打算向她最好的朋友坦白自己的感受……
